# A synthetic loading fixture, isolated from the production dist directory.
add_library(lifecycle SHARED src/plugin.cpp)
target_include_directories(lifecycle PRIVATE "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk" "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party")
target_link_libraries(lifecycle PRIVATE Threads::Threads)
set(package "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/testing/$<CONFIG>/plugins/lifecycle")
set_target_properties(lifecycle PROPERTIES PREFIX "" RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${package}/bin" LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${package}/bin")
set(PLUGIN_ENTRY "bin/lifecycle${CMAKE_SHARED_LIBRARY_SUFFIX}")
configure_file(info.toml "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/info.toml" @ONLY)
foreach(resource info.toml protocol.h protocol.md)
  if(resource STREQUAL "info.toml")
    set(resource_path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${resource}")
  else()
    set(resource_path "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${resource}")
  endif()
  file(GENERATE OUTPUT "${package}/${resource}" INPUT "${resource_path}")
endforeach()
if(MINGW)
  add_custom_command(TARGET lifecycle POST_BUILD COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${CITLALI_WINPTHREAD}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:lifecycle>/libwinpthread-1.dll")
endif()
